name: swarm-studio-ui
description: The Studio's next UI: Vite, React 19, TypeScript, XState and React Aria (docs/decisions/0013-react-ui-coexists.md). Development only: its build, ui/dist/, is made by CI on every branch and committed only on the release the catalog pins (docs/decisions/0018-next-ui-build-on-release.md), and the plugin's server serves it at /next/, so installing the plugin builds and downloads nothing. It lives here, not at the plugin's root, so `hermes plugins install` finds no package.json to offer to install.
